title: Hello!!!! 👋 Welcome to INNOVEDGE SIH Premier 2026.....
content:
🎉 Hello everyone, and a warm welcome to INNOVEDGE SIH Premier 2026!!!!
We are delighted to have all participating teams join us for this exciting innovation journey. 🚀

Please make sure your team details, project information, and pitch deck proposal are completed accurately and submitted within the specified deadline.

📌 Important reminders:

 Upload your pitch deck in PDF format (less than 3 MB). 

 Review your team and project details carefully before submission. 

 Keep checking the Team Leader Portal for official announcements and important updates.  

We wish every team the very best! Bring your ideas, creativity, teamwork, and innovation to the forefront. 🌟

Let’s innovate. Let’s collaborate. Let’s build something impactful! 🚀
author: SIH Premier Committee
